name: GM Digital Signature for Wpforms
author: theme funda

sections.description:
Digital Signature for WPForms is the easiest way to collect legally binding electronic signatures through your WordPress forms.

Stop printing, scanning, and emailing documents. With this free WPForms addon, your users can sign contracts, consent forms, service agreements, and legal documents directly inside any WPForm — on any device, in seconds.

Whether you’re a freelancer, business owner, legal professional, or WordPress developer, this plugin gives you a smooth, professional signature pad with zero coding required.

🔗 Get the Pro Version | Contact Support | Documentation

🖊️ What Is Digital Signature for WPForms?

This plugin adds a drag-and-drop digital signature field to the WPForms form builder. Once placed on your form, visitors can draw their signature using a mouse, stylus, or finger — and the signature is saved automatically with the form entry.

Ideal use cases:
– Business contracts and service agreements
– Client onboarding and consent forms
– Employee or volunteer agreements
– Event waivers and liability release forms
– Legal documents requiring a verified signature

✅ Free Features

  • One-Click Installation — Up and running in minutes, no coding needed
  • Drag-and-Drop Field — Add the signature field to any WPForm just like any standard field
  • Multiple Signature Fields — Collect signatures from multiple parties on a single form
  • Signature in Email Notifications — Submitted signatures are automatically included in WPForms email alerts
  • Touchscreen & Mouse Support — Fully compatible with desktop, tablet, and mobile devices
  • Responsive Signature Canvas — Clean, professional signing experience on any screen size
  • Works with Free & Pro WPForms — No premium WPForms license required

⭐ Pro Features – Upgrade for Full Customization

Take full control of your signature field with Digital Signature for WPForms Pro:

  • Custom Canvas Width & Height — Resize the signature pad to match your form layout
  • Background Color Control — Match the signature pad to your brand or site design
  • Pen/Ink Color Customization — Set a custom pen color for a polished, branded look

🔒 Secure Signature Storage

Every digital signature is stored securely alongside the form submission in your WordPress database. Signatures are tied to their specific form entry, providing a clear audit trail for authenticity and traceability.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions

Does this plugin require WPForms?

Yes. Digital Signature for WPForms is a WPForms addon. You must have the WPForms plugin (free or pro) installed and active on your WordPress site.

Can I add multiple signature fields to one form?

Yes! You can add as many signature fields as needed — perfect for agreements requiring signatures from multiple parties.

Will the signature appear in WPForms email notifications?

Yes. The captured signature image is automatically included in email notifications triggered by WPForms after form submission.

Does the signature field work on mobile and tablets?

Yes. The signature pad fully supports touch input and works seamlessly on smartphones, tablets, and desktop browsers.

Is the signature data stored securely?

Yes. Signature data is saved with the form entry in your WordPress database, linked to the specific submission for full traceability.

How do I change the size or color of the signature pad?

Custom canvas size, background color, and pen color are available exclusively in the Pro version.

Are electronic signatures collected by this plugin legally binding?

In many jurisdictions, electronic signatures are legally valid. However, legal requirements vary by country and use case. We recommend consulting a legal professional to confirm compliance for your specific situation.

  • Autocomplete Location Field for Contact Form 7 — Smart location autocomplete for CF7
  • Date Picker for Contact Form 7 — Simplified date input for CF7 forms
sections.installation:
Option 1: Install from WordPress Plugin Directory
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New.
2. Search for “Digital Signature for WPForms”.
3. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Option 2: Manual Upload
1. Download the plugin .zip file.
2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
3. Upload the file and click Install Now, then Activate.

After Activation:
1. Open any existing WPForm or create a new one.
2. Drag the Digital Signature field from the field panel into your form.
3. Save your form — users can now sign digitally on submission!

Requirements:
– WordPress 5.0 or higher
– WPForms (free or pro) must be installed and active
– PHP 7.2 or higher
